verses.original: נָֽקְטָ֥ה נַפְשִׁ֗י בְּחַ֫יָּ֥י אֶֽעֶזְבָ֣ה עָלַ֣י שִׂיחִ֑י אֲ֝דַבְּרָה֗ בְּמַ֣ר נַפְשִֽׁי׃
verses.transliteration: nā·qə·ṭāh nap̄·šî bə·ḥay·yāy ’e·‘ez·ḇāh ‘ā·lay śî·ḥî ’ă·ḏab·bə·rāh bə·mar nap̄·šî
verses.literal: I loathe my own life I will express . . . my complaint and speak in the bitterness of my soul
verses.literalPt: A minha alma tem tédio à minha vida; darei livre curso à minha queixa, falarei na amargura da minha alma.

verses.original: אֹמַ֣ר אֶל־ אֱ֭לוֹהַּ אַל־ תַּרְשִׁיעֵ֑נִי הֽ֝וֹדִיעֵ֗נִי עַ֣ל מַה־ תְּרִיבֵֽנִי׃
verses.transliteration: ’ō·mar ’el- ’ĕ·lō·w·ah ’al- tar·šî·‘ê·nî hō·w·ḏî·‘ê·nî ‘al mah- tə·rî·ḇê·nî
verses.literal: I will say to God Do not condemn me Let me know why . . . You prosecute me
verses.literalPt: Direi a Deus: Não me condenes; faze-me saber porque contendes comigo.

verses.original: הֲט֤וֹב לְךָ֨׀ כִּֽי־ תַעֲשֹׁ֗ק כִּֽי־ תִ֭מְאַס יְגִ֣יעַ כַּפֶּ֑יךָ וְעַל־ עֲצַ֖ת רְשָׁעִ֣ים הוֹפָֽעְתָּ׃
verses.transliteration: hă·ṭō·wḇ lə·ḵā kî- ṯa·‘ă·šōq kî- ṯim·’as yə·ḡî·a‘ kap·pe·ḵā wə·‘al- ‘ă·ṣaṯ rə·šā·‘îm hō·w·p̄ā·‘ə·tā
verses.literal: Does it please You . . . to oppress me . . . to reject the work of Your hands . . . and favor the schemes of the wicked
verses.literalPt: Porventura, tens prazer em oprimir, em rejeitar a obra das tuas mãos e em favorecer o conselho dos iníquos?

verses.original: הַעֵינֵ֣י בָשָׂ֣ר לָ֑ךְ אִם־ כִּרְא֖וֹת אֱנ֣וֹשׁ תִּרְאֶֽה׃
verses.transliteration: ha·‘ê·nê ḇā·śār lāḵ ’im- kir·’ō·wṯ ’ĕ·nō·wōš tir·’eh
verses.literal: Do You have eyes of flesh Do You see as man sees
verses.literalPt: Acaso, tens tu olhos de carne ou vês tu como vê o homem?

verses.original: הֲכִימֵ֣י אֱנ֣וֹשׁ יָמֶ֑יךָ אִם־ שְׁ֝נוֹתֶ֗יךָ כִּ֣ימֵי גָֽבֶר׃
verses.transliteration: hă·ḵî·mê ’ĕ·nō·wōš yā·me·ḵā ’i·mōš- šə·nô·t̲ê·k̲ā kî·mê ḡā·ḇer
verses.literal: Are Your days like those of a mortal or Your years like those of a man
verses.literalPt: São os teus dias como os dias do homem ou os teus anos, como os anos do homem,

verses.original: כִּֽי־ תְבַקֵּ֥שׁ לַעֲוֺנִ֑י וּ֭לְחַטָּאתִ֥י תִדְרֽוֹשׁ׃
verses.transliteration: kî- ṯə·ḇaq·qêš la·‘ă·wō·nî ū·lə·ḥaṭ·ṭā·ṯî ṯiḏ·rō·wōš
verses.literal: that You should seek my iniquity and search out my sin
verses.literalPt: para te informares da minha iniquidade e averiguares o meu pecado?

verses.original: עַֽל־ דַּ֭עְתְּךָ כִּי־ לֹ֣א אֶרְשָׁ֑ע וְאֵ֖ין מִיָּדְךָ֣ מַצִּֽיל׃
verses.transliteration: ‘al- da‘·tə·ḵā kî- lō ’er·šā‘ wə·’ên mî·yā·ḏə·ḵā maṣ·ṣîl
verses.literal: though You know that I am not guilty and there is no deliverance from Your hand
verses.literalPt: Sabendo tu que eu não sou iníquo, não há ninguém que possa livrar da tua mão.

verses.original: יָדֶ֣יךָ עִ֭צְּבוּנִי וַֽיַּעֲשׂ֑וּנִי יַ֥חַד סָ֝בִ֗יב וַֽתְּבַלְּעֵֽנִי׃
verses.transliteration: yā·ḏe·ḵā ‘iṣ·ṣə·ḇū·nî way·ya·‘ă·śū·nî ya·ḥaḏ sā·ḇîḇ wat·tə·ḇal·lə·‘ê·nî
verses.literal: Your hands shaped me and altogether formed me Would You now turn and destroy me
verses.literalPt: As tuas mãos me fizeram e me formaram, todo em roda… e tu me consomes!

verses.original: זְכָר־ נָ֭א כִּי־ כַחֹ֣מֶר עֲשִׂיתָ֑נִי וְֽאֶל־ עָפָ֥ר תְּשִׁיבֵֽנִי׃
verses.transliteration: zə·ḵār- nā kî- ḵa·ḥō·mer ‘ă·śî·ṯā·nî wə·’el- ‘ā·p̄ār tə·šî·ḇê·nî
verses.literal: Please remember that You molded me like clay Would You now return me to dust
verses.literalPt: Lembra-te, pois, de que, como barro, me fizeste; e queres reduzir-me a pó?

verses.original: הֲלֹ֣א כֶ֭חָלָב תַּתִּיכֵ֑נִי וְ֝כַגְּבִנָּ֗ה תַּקְפִּיאֵֽנִי׃
verses.transliteration: hă·lō ḵe·ḥā·lāḇ tat·tî·ḵê·nî wə·ḵag·gə·ḇin·nāh taq·pî·’ê·nî
verses.literal: Did You not pour me out like milk and curdle me like cheese
verses.literalPt: Porventura, não me vazaste como leite e não me coalhaste como queijo?

verses.original: ע֣וֹר וּ֭בָשָׂר תַּלְבִּישֵׁ֑נִי וּֽבַעֲצָמ֥וֹת וְ֝גִידִ֗ים תְּסֹכְכֵֽנִי׃
verses.transliteration: ‘ō·wr ū·ḇā·śār tal·bî·šê·nî ū·ḇa·‘ă·ṣā·mō·wṯ wə·ḡî·ḏîm tə·sō·ḵə·ḵê·nî
verses.literal: You clothed me with skin and flesh and knit me together with bones and sinews
verses.literalPt: De pele e de carne me vestiste e de ossos e de nervos me teceste.

verses.original: חַיִּ֣ים וָ֭חֶסֶד עָשִׂ֣יתָ עִמָּדִ֑י וּ֝פְקֻדָּתְךָ֗ שָֽׁמְרָ֥ה רוּחִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: ḥay·yîm wā·ḥe·seḏ ‘ā·śî·ṯā ‘im·mā·ḏî ū·p̄ə·qud·dā·ṯə·ḵā šā·mə·rāh rū·ḥî
verses.literal: You have granted me life and loving devotion and Your care has preserved my spirit
verses.literalPt: Vida e misericórdia me tens concedido, e a tua providência tem conservado o meu espírito.

verses.original: וְ֭אֵלֶּה צָפַ֣נְתָּ בִלְבָבֶ֑ךָ יָ֝דַ֗עְתִּי כִּי־ זֹ֥את עִמָּֽךְ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’êl·leh ṣā·p̄an·tā ḇil·ḇā·ḇe·ḵā yā·ḏa‘·tî kî- zōṯ ‘im·māḵ
verses.literal: Yet You concealed these things in Your heart and I know that this was in Your mind
verses.literalPt: Contudo, ocultaste essas coisas no teu coração; sei que isso está no teu espírito.

verses.original: אִם־ חָטָ֥אתִי וּשְׁמַרְתָּ֑נִי וּ֝מֵעֲוֺנִ֗י לֹ֣א תְנַקֵּֽנִי׃
verses.transliteration: ’im- ḥā·ṭā·ṯî ū·šə·mar·tā·nî ū·mê·‘ă·wō·nî lō ṯə·naq·qê·nî
verses.literal: If I sinned You would take note and would not acquit me of my iniquity
verses.literalPt: Se eu pecar, tu me observas e não me absolverás da minha iniquidade.

verses.original: אִם־ רָשַׁ֡עְתִּי אַלְלַ֬י לִ֗י וְ֭צָדַקְתִּי לֹא־ אֶשָּׂ֣א רֹאשִׁ֑י שְׂבַ֥ע קָ֝ל֗וֹן וּרְאֵ֥ה עָנְיִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: ’im- rā·ša‘·tî ’al·lay lî wə·ṣā·ḏaq·tî lō- ’eś·śā rō·šî śə·ḇa‘ qā·lō·wn ū·rə·’êh ‘ā·nə·yî
verses.literal: If I am guilty woe to me And even if I am righteous I cannot lift my head I am full of shame and aware of my affliction
verses.literalPt: Se eu for iníquo, ai de mim; ainda que seja justo, não levantarei a minha cabeça, estando farto de ignomínia, e de contemplar a minha aflição.

verses.original: וְ֭יִגְאֶה כַּשַּׁ֣חַל תְּצוּדֵ֑נִי וְ֝תָשֹׁ֗ב תִּתְפַּלָּא־ בִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: wə·yiḡ·’eh kaš·ša·ḥal tə·ṣū·ḏê·nî wə·ṯā·šōḇ tiṯ·pal·lā- ḇî
verses.literal: Should I hold my head high You would hunt me like a lion and again display Your power against me
verses.literalPt: Se a minha cabeça se exaltar, tu me caçarás como um leão feroz; e tornarás a mostrar-te em maravilhas contra mim.

verses.original: תְּחַדֵּ֬שׁ עֵדֶ֨יךָ׀ נֶגְדִּ֗י וְתֶ֣רֶב כַּֽ֭עַשְׂךָ עִמָּדִ֑י חֲלִיפ֖וֹת וְצָבָ֣א עִמִּֽי׃
verses.transliteration: tə·ḥad·dêš ‘ê·ḏe·ḵā neḡ·dî wə·ṯe·reḇ ka·‘aś·ḵā ‘im·mā·ḏî ḥă·lî·p̄ō·wṯ wə·ṣā·ḇā ‘im·mî
verses.literal: You produce new witnesses against me and multiply Your anger toward me Hardships assault me in wave after wave
verses.literalPt: Renovarás as tuas testemunhas contra mim e multiplicarás a tua indignação sobre mim. Revezar-se-ão contra mim tropas de males.

verses.original: וְלָ֣מָּה מֵ֭רֶחֶם הֹצֵאתָ֑נִי אֶ֝גְוַ֗ע וְעַ֣יִן לֹא־ תִרְאֵֽנִי׃
verses.transliteration: wə·lām·māh mê·re·ḥem hō·ṣê·ṯā·nî ’eḡ·wa‘ wə·‘a·yin lō- ṯir·’ê·nî
verses.literal: Why then did You bring me from the womb Oh, that I had died and no eye had seen me
verses.literalPt: Por que, pois, me tiraste da madre? Eu tivera expirado, e nenhum olho me tivera visto.

verses.original: כַּאֲשֶׁ֣ר לֹא־ הָיִ֣יתִי אֶהְיֶ֑ה מִ֝בֶּ֗טֶן לַקֶּ֥בֶר אוּבָֽל׃
verses.transliteration: ka·’ă·šer lō- hā·yî·ṯî ’eh·yeh mib·be·ṭen laq·qe·ḇer ’ū·ḇāl
verses.literal: If only I had never come to be but had been carried from the womb to the grave
verses.literalPt: Eu teria sido como se nunca fora; da madre teria sido levado para a sepultura.

verses.original: הֲלֹא־ מְעַ֣ט יָמַ֣י יֶחְדָּל יָשִׁית מִ֝מֶּ֗נִּי וְאַבְלִ֥יגָה מְּעָֽט׃
verses.transliteration: hă·lō- mə·‘aṭ yā·may yɛḥ·då̄l yå̄·šīṯ mim·men·nî wə·’aḇ·lî·ḡāh mə·‘āṭ
verses.literal: Are my days not few Withdraw . . . from me that I may have a little comfort
verses.literalPt: Não são poucos os meus dias? Cessa, pois, e deixa-me, para que, por um pouco, eu tome alento.

verses.original: בְּטֶ֣רֶם אֵ֭לֵךְ וְלֹ֣א אָשׁ֑וּב אֶל־ אֶ֖רֶץ חֹ֣שֶׁךְ וְצַלְמָֽוֶת׃
verses.transliteration: bə·ṭe·rem ’ê·lêḵ wə·lō ’ā·šūḇ ’el- ’e·reṣ ḥō·šeḵ wə·ṣal·mā·weṯ
verses.literal: before I go never to return to a land of darkness and gloom
verses.literalPt: Antes que eu vá para o lugar de que não voltarei, para a terra das trevas e da sombra da morte,

verses.original: אֶ֤רֶץ עֵיפָ֨תָה׀ כְּמ֥וֹ אֹ֗פֶל צַ֭לְמָוֶת וְלֹ֥א סְדָרִ֗ים וַתֹּ֥פַע כְּמוֹ־ אֹֽפֶל׃פ
verses.transliteration: ’e·reṣ ‘ê·p̄ā·ṯāh kə·mōw ’ō·p̄el ṣal·mā·weṯ wə·lō sə·ḏā·rîm wat·tō·p̄a‘ kə·mōw- ’ō·p̄el
verses.literal: to a land of utter darkness . . . . . . of deep shadow and disorder . . . where even the light is like darkness
verses.literalPt: terra escuríssima, como a mesma escuridão, terra da sombra da morte, sem ordem alguma e onde a própria luz é escuridão.
